**Calculate the $L^2$ norm on bounded support:** The error has a bounded support of length $2\theta_{\lceil \kappa/2 \rceil}$, where $\theta_{\lceil \kappa/2 \rceil}$ is the outermost knot position.
**Integrate over all viewing rays:** Integrate the error estimate over all viewing rays and relate the result to the $L^2$ norm $\kappa$ of the normalized particle contribution.
*   **Error Growth Assumption:** For $d > 0$, quantization errors grow along the ray until the next knot.
The combined estimate requires $O(D)$ operations to sum over all orders.
